name: Creamy Garlic Herb Pork Chops

fit.batch_format: skillet pan-sauce chops, no starch base - scales cleanly for meal prep

dup_check.evidence: Nearest catalog pork-chop cream dish is Creamy Mushroom Pork Chops, but that is a mushroom-cream/broth sauce (flour-thickened) served over mashed russet potatoes; this candidate is a garlic-herb white-wine + parmesan + lemon cream pan sauce with an almond-flour dredge and NO starch base - different sauce flavor family and different plate, so not a duplicate.
dup_check.other_catalog_chops_ruled_out: marry-me-pork-chops-over-pasta is a sun-dried-tomato cream sauce over pasta; countryfried-pork-chops-with-bacon-gravy is a breaded fried chop with bacon gravy - neither matches this garlic-herb-wine no-starch chop.

cross_protein_flags: Structurally this is a 'creamy garlic-herb white-wine pan sauce over a pan-seared cutlet, no starch' dish - the SAUCE is protein-agnostic. Watch for a chicken-lane 'creamy garlic herb chicken skillet' or a turkey/pork-tenderloin cutlet in the same garlic-herb-cream/wine sauce; those would be same-dish-different-protein twins. Distinct from the already-accepted creamy-tuscan-chicken-skillet (that is sun-dried-tomato + spinach Tuscan, a different sauce).
notes: Widens spread as a low-carb non-Tuscan cream chop; carries two genuine unmapped signature ingredients (almond-flour dredge, dry white wine) that exercise the pricer lane as intended.
